flags.sentence: Pirkanmaa's crude treatment shares exceed national values, so its main pathway gaps lie in unmonitored local target times and unmeasured access times from referral to treatment start.
flags.problem: Overreach: exceeding national crude (unadjusted, overlapping) treatment-share benchmarks does not establish that Pirkanmaa's main pathway gaps are limited to unmonitored local target times and unmeasured referral-to-treatment access times, nor do the cited claims rank or exhaust Pirkanmaa's pathway gaps.
